class: A test run leaves a row in a live settings or rates table that overrides the real value, and the app uses the leftover.
mechanism: The brokerage-per-order rate has a row set by a test step that was never removed; the newer row wins over the value read from the broker's page.

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX data read (dev database, read-only), 15 Nov 2026
first_seen.evidence: The stored brokerage-per-order rate has a leftover row of 25 from 1 Nov ('GC-SET step 2 proof') over the 20 read from the broker's public page on 15 Oct. The user test of 13 Nov showed 25 per order.

fix: None yet. Open for owner decision: put the rate back to 20.

detection.note: Unguarded: no check compares the stored rate with the published one.
